title: Jack Dorsey's Bitchat disappears from app stores in India after government order | TechCrunch
summary: Bitchat, Jack Dorsey’s decentralized messaging app designed to work without an internet connection, has disappeared from Apple and Google’s app stores in India, months after New Delhi first sought to restrict access to the open-source software.
